topography.project_purpose: Liquity is a decentralized borrowing protocol that allows users to draw interest-free loans against ETH and liquid staking tokens (LSTs) as collateral. Loans are paid out in the stablecoin BOLD, and the system maintains stability through a set of collateral-specific pools and a global stability mechanism. The protocol also includes governance and staking tokens (LQTY, LUSD) for incentivizing participation and managing the system.
topography.relationship_narrative: Each collateral branch (ETH, rETH, wstETH) operates independently with its own set of core pools and managers, but all branches share the BOLD token as the common debt currency and rely on the CollateralRegistry for cross-branch coordination. The Governance family provides system-wide incentives and control, while Shared contracts offer helper functions used by all branches.
